description: Before the run: the search method («способ поиска») — people (search people directly), companies_first (find the companies, then the people in them), via_related_people; only the options get_search detail=spec lists for this spec. task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

version.description: The spec version from get_search (optional: protects against an edit made meanwhile in the web).
